original_query: What are the three types of Fabric manufacturing technology?

summaries.found_via_query: three types of Fabric manufacturing technology
summaries.summary: The image displays a flow chart titled 'Flow chart of fabric manufacturing technology,' which categorizes fabric manufacturing into three main types: Weaving, Knitting, and Non-Woven. Under Weaving, it further breaks down into Weaving preparation (Winding, Warping, Sizing) and Weaving mechanism (Tappet, Dobby, Jacquard). Knitting is subdivided into Warp knitting and Weft knitting.
key_facts: Three main types of fabric manufacturing technology: Weaving, Knitting, and Non-Woven
Weaving includes Weaving preparation (Winding, Warping, Sizing) and Weaving mechanism (Tappet, Dobby, Jacquard)
Knitting includes Warp knitting and Weft knitting
